scope: Structural checks only; not full OpenAPI spec validator or implemented API behavior.
checks: Operation IDs unique; all path variables declared
All component schemas satisfy JSON Schema 2020-12 syntax
RunCreate accepts a valid typed request
RunCreate rejects role/source/grants/tools and unsupported adaptive mode
SQLite schema creates and integrity check passes
Two independent owner fixtures and self-rooted Runs can be inserted
Conversation cannot refer to another owner workspace
A Run cannot attach to another owner budget root

Background resource cannot be bound to another owner root Run
Internal result Run requires an origin reference
Foreign-key check remains clean after fixtures and negative cases
